items.q: He quit drinking and he joined George, uh, John Kirby. He hadn't had a drink in 6 months and I went in Joe Hawkes place

ctx.x: I was going to ask you about him next, a great drummer with the John Kirby band.

With John Kirby. But before he was with the Blue Mills Rhythm Boys... He quit drinking and he joined George, uh, John Kirby. He hadn't had a drink in 6 months and I went in Joe Hawkes place and I said, "I want to buy him a beer. This is his birthday; he hasn't had a drink in 6 months." And he took a drink and then he took up knitting, which was a very therapeutic thing. You know, John was with Maxine Sullivan and they went out and did tours and what have you.
